proof_dependency_chain: Construct the Stone space of ultrafilters on the natural numbers and retain its actual compact/Hausdorff/totally disconnected instances.
Prove the full universe-polymorphic lifting property of every ultrafilter Stone space by extending arbitrary choices on dense principal points.
Show the open set of principal diagonal points has closure equal to the whole diagonal.
Prove that this diagonal cannot be open by compactness and the infinite injection of principal points.
Construct a closed two-sheet profinite cover of the product and prove its projection continuous and onto.
A continuous section would identify the nonopen diagonal with the preimage of an open singleton, giving the contradiction.
boundary_checks: Treat separate lifting in each parameter as a jointly continuous lift.
Replace the explicit obstruction by an unsupported slogan about extremal disconnectedness.

formalization.scope: Actual-object main theorem or complete counterexample, with each reference result itemized in COVERAGE.md.
